_comment: EXP-1170: the NEW ISSUE page, identical x4 (web lib/issue-draft-page.ts, desktop domain::issue_draft, iOS ExpCore IssueDraftPage, Android domain/IssueDraftPage). There is no create dialog: every New issue opener mints a draft uuid and navigates to the issue detail IN DRAFT MODE, the same layout as the detail with only these differences: the identifier slot reads `header`, the trailing cluster is a primary `create` button and a close (`ui-close`) button whose tooltip/accessibility label is `discard` (EXP-1191: no one-item overflow menu), the body is title (placeholder `titlePlaceholder`, focused on open), property chips (status, priority, assignee, labels, due date, a board picker when the team has more than one board; no estimate), description (placeholder `descriptionPlaceholder`) and the draft's Files, nothing else. AUTOSAVE: one coalesced `issueDrafts.upsert` of the full row, `debounceMs` after the last title/description edit, at once on a chip change, on blur, on leaving the page and before Create; a title, description or attachment is content, chips alone never create a row; leaving an emptied existing draft deletes it. A draft with no title lists as `untitled`. EXP-1212: a draft WITH content (title, description or attachment) never goes silently. DISCARD (the close button) first asks `discardConfirm` (title, body, a destructive `confirm`, the platform's Cancel); a draft with no content discards at once. LEAVING the page any other way (back, a nav entry, opening another screen, closing its IDE tab) is HELD and asks `leave`: `create` (the page's Create, disabled without a title; the held navigation then continues instead of opening the new issue), `keep` (save, then continue) or `discard` (delete, then continue; no second confirmation); dismissing the dialog stays on the page. A draft with no content leaves silently and is deleted as before. Quitting the app or closing the browser tab is not held (the autosave keeps the draft). Details x4: while the file list of a reopened draft is not known yet it counts as content; nothing is asked while a Create is in flight; `keep` that fails to save stays on the page with the save error; a mode that never writes a draft row (a sub-issue or share compose on phones) offers `create` and `discard` only, no `keep`; the dialog never puts keyboard focus on `discard`.

discardConfirm.title: Discard draft?
discardConfirm.body: This draft and its files will be deleted.

leave.title: This issue is still a draft
leave.body: Create it now, keep it as a draft or discard it.
